title: The claude-tmux driver sends one typed authorizing line after the pasted prompt, so the agent does not decline it as untrusted
summary: From cycle 1734 (wave 24; design doc §5.11 T3). The claude agent read the whole bracketed-paste prompt as untrusted pasted text and refused to write triage-report.md, and refused the one-shot nudge the same way; the bridge treated the idle pane as a stall (exit 81 after 900s). The identity block (P3) sits inside the paste, so it cannot authorize it.
acceptance: After the bracketed paste, the driver sends one fixed user-typed line naming the phase and cycle that asks the agent to carry out the pasted prompt (driver test pins the keystrokes)
A replay of 1734's triage prompt through the driver yields a written triage-report.md, not a refusal
